runtime.note: CPython, yt-dlp, yt-dlp-ejs, QuickJS-NG qjs, aria2c, and Jsoup are bundled for arm64-v8a and x86_64. The qjs and aria2c executables are installed into app-private storage, self-tested, and connected to yt-dlp. No runtime package downloads are performed. aria2c is used for supported HTTP(S) transfers; segmented HLS/DASH continues using yt-dlp's internal downloader. FFmpeg/FFprobe JNI are provided by the pinned LGPL AAR; a yt-dlp-compatible ffmpeg executable is not provided.

packages.name: CPython
packages.description: Embedded CPython runtime included in APK for arm64-v8a and x86_64.

packages.name: yt-dlp
packages.description: Python package bundled in APK for supported site extraction, format analysis and downloads; site availability varies. Separate-stream merging is unavailable without an ffmpeg CLI adapter.

packages.name: yt-dlp-ejs
packages.description: EJS challenge solver scripts are bundled and yt-dlp is configured to use the bundled QuickJS-NG qjs runtime; platform restrictions and upstream changes can still prevent extraction.

packages.name: QuickJS
packages.description: qjs command-line runtime bundled for arm64-v8a and x86_64 and selected explicitly by yt-dlp for EJS challenges. Runtime startup is self-tested on device.

packages.name: Jsoup
packages.description: JVM HTML parsing fallback for static Open Graph and video metadata; does not execute JavaScript.

packages.name: FFmpeg
packages.description: FFmpeg and FFprobe JNI APIs bundled in APK for arm64-v8a and x86_64; LGPL artifact. No yt-dlp CLI adapter; GPL codecs excluded.

packages.name: aria2
packages.description: Android aria2c command-line binaries bundled for arm64-v8a and x86_64. yt-dlp uses bounded multi-connection downloads for supported HTTP(S) streams; native handling remains enabled for HLS/DASH.

packages.name: Deno
packages.description: Not included; no JavaScript challenge runtime is bundled.

packages.name: Node.js
packages.description: Not included; no JavaScript challenge runtime is bundled.

packages.name: Coil Compose
packages.description: Compose image loading for remote media thumbnails; images load only when enabled in settings.

packages.name: AndroidX Media3 ExoPlayer
packages.description: ExoPlayer and PlayerView for user-initiated preview playback and local video history.

packages.name: AndroidX WorkManager KTX
packages.description: Durable queued downloads, retry scheduling and foreground progress notifications. OS battery/network policies may defer tasks; uninstall removes active work.

packages.name: Jetpack Compose Material Icons Extended
packages.description: Icons used by the Compose Android interface.
